spec.description: Parameters that define the accuracy and speed of TDigest

buffer.description: Stores values waiting to merge into the clusters

mergeBackwards.description:
Sets merge in opposite direction to mitigate direction bias in errors from merging
Default set to false, fill be flipped after each merge automatically

count.description: Keeps track of total points in all clusters of this TDigest

clusters.description: Stores the current clusters in the TDigest sorted by mean

name: TDigest
